name: Fíngein

attributes.attribute: a minor king in some tales

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Fíngein is a hero of Irish narrative. The name appears often in the tales. It belongs to several healers and to some minor kings. In Irish story he is known above all for his skill in healing.

okr.objective: Fíngein is an Irish hero known for healing.
key_results: The name is common in Irish narratives.
Some minor kings bear it as well.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore
